goal: Produce explainable, collection-aware roster recommendations without confusing legality, popularity, mathematical efficiency, tournament performance and expert opinion.

normative_legality.requirement: Candidate roster/build must be legal under the declared current rules/points snapshot.

physical_feasibility.required_when: recommendation is constrained to the user's owned collection
physical_feasibility.requirement: Candidate must be buildable from the declared collection snapshot or explicitly identify missing purchases/build changes.

patch_alignment.requirement: Primary analytics evidence must belong to the same rules/points patch or be explicitly normalized across the change.

temporal_policy.patch_boundary: Do not pool pre-update and post-update evidence as one sample when rules, points, datasheets or detachment access changed materially.
temporal_policy.older_evidence: historical_context_only unless no newer evidence exists
temporal_policy.requirement: Every recommendation records analytics_window_start/end and rules_snapshot_id.

independence_policy.rule: Aggregate confidence once per underlying evidence lineage before combining lineages.
independence_policy.unresolved_lineage: Do not claim independent confirmation until upstream provenance is known.

confidence_rules.HIGH: Legal/current + at least 3 independent evidence lineages + no material contradiction + adequate sample.
confidence_rules.MEDIUM: Legal/current + at least 2 independent lineages or one strong empirical lineage plus independent expert/math support.
confidence_rules.LOW: Sparse sample, one lineage, cross-source disagreement, or significant modelling assumptions.

output_contract: State the analytics time window and patch.
State the roster role the candidate is intended to fill.
Separate observed tournament evidence from derived models and expert opinion.
State collection/build feasibility separately from competitive strength.
Never label popularity as effectiveness without performance evidence.
Never label mathhammer efficiency as table strength without role/mission evidence.
